name: Boon Of Exquisite Radiance
description: Epic Boon Feat (Prerequisite: Level 19+) You gain the following benefits.

features.name: Ability Score Increase
features.description: Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 30.

features.name: Eternal Rest
features.description: Creatures you reduce to 0 Hit Points can’t become Undead.

features.name: Powerful Radiance
features.description: When you make a damage roll that deals Radiant damage, you can instead use the highest number possible for each damage die. Once you use this benefit, you can’t do so again until you finish a Long Rest.
